meta.format: JSON snapshot held in IndexedDB transactional record
meta.atomicCommit: IDB single readwrite transaction for checkpoint and metadata

transactionLedger.rules: All item consumption, reward grant and flag update must happen atomically in one transaction

invariants: All itemInstance.uid values globally unique within save; no negative quantities or duplicate ownership
All ids reference canonical ItemDB, RecipeDB, BuildDB, CaveDB, POIDB, PuzzleDB, SkillDB
A unique POI, story item or blueprint may be claimed only once per save with idempotent claimKey
Partial project deliveries removed once from player/container inventory and stored once in project escrow
A completed crafting output cannot appear before consumed input is committed
Save time does not advance while tab hidden or browser offline; sleeping advances clock by explicit eventId once
Player cannot spawn inside solid tile, water without appropriate mode or disabled cave exit
Cave return transition always resolves to corresponding entrancePoi walkable anchor
Vehicle mode and player position match; on invalid coordinate restore last safe landing and keep vehicle
POI puzzle world flags and story rewards committed together; game restart cannot regrant the same reward
Weather, rain collector yields, crop growth and traps use distinct idempotent daily event keys
A replaced or upgraded building retains its entity UID, inventory contents and production queues
Installed critical story power parts are persistent story flags, never consumable duplicate items
checkpointProtocol: Build immutable snapshot copy from single simulation tick (pause mutations during capture)
Validate ids, quantities, scene and current clock; serialize typed object to JSON
In one IndexedDB transaction write new snapshot revision, updated slot pointer and metadata; keep prior known-good revision
Only after commit mark visible saved status; on failure retain prior revision and offer manual export
On load verify version + content hashes + all entity IDs; migrate into memory then validate before overwriting
On conflicting second tab, acquire lease with owner id and lease heartbeat while visible; if not owner, disallow writes
At game pause (visibilitychange hidden) stop simulation and checkpoint if possible; not rely on unload events alone

sleepDailyTick.safeguard: Store lastProcessedDay + processedEventId; crops/traps/weather/resource regen advance by integer day boundary only once; explicit leap through each affected day with capped batch if long sleep

transitionProtocol.caveEnter: Validate door anchor; prepare from/to; write checkpoint; place at stored entrance; commit transition; never save intermediate void position
transitionProtocol.caveExit: Return to walkable POI approach tile on MAIN; if POI location blocked use nearest valid tile from CollisionNavDB
transitionProtocol.raftBoard: Save raft id and player entity binding atomically; engine transports one shared state
transitionProtocol.raftDisembark: Check foot walkable landing and persist vehicle anchor before changing player mode
transitionProtocol.deathInCave: Respawn at most recent valid bed, create recoverable bag at reachable floor tile near death; no loss of quest items

errorRecovery.invalidCurrentSnapshot: load newest valid previous snapshot, never overwrite without user confirmation
errorRecovery.unknownOldEntityIds: quarantine unknown entities to migration report, keep owner items in recovery container if valid
errorRecovery.crashMidTransaction: idempotency id and previous good revision prevent duplicate grants

testCases: Save in cave then load: same caveId, floor tile, mined resource states and chest status
Save on wooden platform in pond cave: same walkable floor, no forced swim
Save on raft mid sea then load: same raft/passenger, valid water tile and closest safe landing exists
Save mid puzzle: toggles retained; solving and restarting does not re-award
Delivery to unfinished boat + crash: ingredients consumed once, project progress retained
Sleep crossing 3 days with crop/trap queue: each day updated once, no double yields
Open unique blueprint chest with full inventory: reward held in escrow until player collects
Death in cave/drowning: quest items preserved and lost bag reachable
Manual export-import of slot 2 never overwrites slot 1 silently
Two browser tabs never write conflicting revisions to same save
